features.name: Marked for Death
features.short: On a successful weapon attack, mark a Stress to make the target Marked for Death. Your damage against it adds d4s equal to your tier. Only one adversary at a time; lasts until you rest, it is defeated, or the GM spends Fear equal to your tier to clear it.

features.name: Get In & Get Out
features.short: Spend a Hope to ask the GM for a quick or inconspicuous way into or out of a place you can see; your next roll acting on it has advantage.

assassin.executioners-guild.name: First Strike
assassin.executioners-guild.short: Your first successful attack each scene deals double damage.

assassin.executioners-guild.name: Death Strike
assassin.executioners-guild.short: On Severe damage, mark a Stress to make the target mark an additional Hit Point.

assassin.executioners-guild.name: Scorpion’s Poise
assassin.executioners-guild.short: +2 Evasion against creatures you’ve Marked for Death.

assassin.executioners-guild.name: True Strike
assassin.executioners-guild.short: Once per long rest, when you fail an attack, spend a Hope to make it a success.

assassin.poisoners-guild.name: Toxic Concoctions
assassin.poisoners-guild.short: Mark a Stress to place 1d4+1 tokens on this card. On a successful weapon attack, spend a token to poison the target with a poison you know (see Poisons on the domain card sheet). Long rest: clear unspent tokens.

items.name: Grave Spore
items.short: The target also marks a Stress.

items.name: Leech Weed
items.short: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on this attack.

assassin.poisoners-guild.name: Poison Compendium
assassin.poisoners-guild.short: You also know more poisons (see the domain card sheet).

items.name: Midnight Vine
items.short: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until it marks a Stress to clear this.

assassin.poisoners-guild.name: Twin Fang
assassin.poisoners-guild.short: When you poison a Marked for Death target, spend one more token to also apply a second poison you know.

assassin.poisoners-guild.name: Venomancer
assassin.poisoners-guild.short: You also know more poisons (see the domain card sheet).

items.name: Blight Seed
items.short: The target gets -3 to its damage thresholds until the end of the scene; it doesn’t stack.

items.name: Fear Leaf
items.short: Deal extra damage equal to your Fear Die result on this attack.

items.name: Corpse Thorn
items.short: The target has disadvantage on reaction rolls until the end of the scene.

assassin.poisoners-guild.name: Adder’s Blessing
assassin.poisoners-guild.short: You are immune to poisons and other toxins.
